title: URGENT: 내 드라이브에 Audiso Music 폴더 생성
instruction: CEO confirmed Audiso Music missing on Mac Google Drive. Run: bash scripts/mac-create-audiso-music-mydrive.sh AUD-MUS-20260825-004. Creates folder in My Drive (내 드라이브) for okas2000@gmail.com ONLY. Opens Finder. Requires Google Drive for desktop signed into Gmail (not yonsei).
ceo_action: Mac: Drive desktop = okas2000@gmail.com only. Then Finder/Phone → 내 드라이브 → Audiso Music
